# Support

For questions, setup help, or troubleshooting with Hadron:

- **GitHub Discussions**: [github.com/krishujeniya/Hadron/discussions](https://github.com/krishujeniya/Hadron/discussions)
- **Bug Reports & Feature Requests**: [github.com/krishujeniya/Hadron/issues](https://github.com/krishujeniya/Hadron/issues)
- **Security Issues**: See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) — do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.
